newsitem.title: UK: T&N no comment on Kolbenschmidt stake.
newsitem.headline: T&N no comment on Kolbenschmidt stake.

text.p: British-based auto components group T&N Plc said on Friday it could not comment on reports from Germany that it no longer had an option on half of a block of nearly half the shares in piston and bearing firm Kolbenschmidt.

The UK firm's option to buy all 49.99 percent of the shares from Commerzbank had been due to expire at the end of 1996 but last month T&N paid about 8.0 million stg to secure an extended option, until September 1997, on half of this block of shares.
Although T&N said then it intended to make an announcement "shortly" about its option over the other half of the shares, a company spokesman told Reuters it had no comment at present.
